title: —I am no protestant, I tell you again, said Mr Casey, flushing.
html_source:
There was/is a great deal of tension between Protestant Irish and Catholic Irish. (Such protestants are “orange,” and such Catholics are “green”)

The northern part of Ireland ruled by England is primarily protestant, where the remainder is predominately Catholic.
